errors.evidence: The x-axis scale is linear, with tick marks at evenly spaced intervals of 25 (100, 75, 50, 25). It is not logarithmic.
The y-axis label is "Eval PPL." with a period at the end, which is omitted in the description.
The line for "Only MoHD FFN" is a solid gray line with square markers, not a dash-dotted line.
This description of the "Only MoHD FFN" line is an over-generalization. The line does not simply increase; it first dips from ~11.45 at 100% to ~11.3 at 50%, and then rises to ~11.75 at 25%.
The final data point for the "Only MoHD ATTN" line at 25% is clearly above the 14.0 grid line, at a value of approximately 14.25.
The "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line does not dip at 75%. It shows a continuous increase, rising from ~11.4 at 100% to ~11.55 at 75%.
The final data point for the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line at 25% is visibly above the 13.0 grid line, at a value of approximately 13.15.

errors.text_span: The plot demonstrates that sparsity applied to the Attention component leads to a significant increase in Eval PPL as the activated parameter ratio decreases, while sparsity in the FFN component has a much smaller effect.
errors.evidence: This concluding sentence provides an interpretation and conclusion drawn from the data, using subjective evaluative language such as "significant increase" and "much smaller effect," rather than objectively describing the visual information.
